scripts.script:
-- whatHub v1.5 Full Integrated (Enable All Settings master toggle)
-- Last edited: 2025-09-11
-- add me on discord: tennisballs9000

if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DarkNetworks/Infinite-Yield/main/latest.lua'))()

-- ===== Services =====
local Players            = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService         = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace          = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInput          = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting           = game:GetService("Lighting")
local StarterGui         = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local ReplicatedStorage  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Remove any previous whatHub GUIs
pcall(function()
    local pg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    for _, gui in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
        if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and (gui.Name:match("^whatHub") or gui.Name:match("^whatHub_v")) then
            gui:Destroy()
        end
    end
end)

-- Rayfield loader - try a few times
local Rayfield
do
    local attempts, maxAttempts, lastErr = 0, 3, nil
    while attempts < maxAttempts do
        attempts = attempts + 1
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()
        end)
        if ok and res then
            Rayfield = res
            break
        else
            lastErr = res
            task.wait(0.6)
        end
    end
    if not Rayfield then
        pcall(function()
            StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "whatHub v1.5",
                Text = "Rayfield failed to load, UI will use fallback.",
                Duration = 6
            })
        end)
        Rayfield = {
            CreateWindow = function() 
                return {
                    CreateTab = function() 
                        return {
                            CreateButton = function(_) end,
                            CreateToggle = function(_) end,
                            CreateSlider = function(_) end,
                            CreateSearch = function(_) end,
                            CreateDropdown = function(_) end
                        } 
                    end
                }
            end,
            Notify = function() end
        }
    end
end

-- Safe debug printing
local function dprint(...)
    if _G.whatHubDebug then
        local args = table.pack(...)
        local out = {}
        for i = 1, args.n do out[i] = tostring(args[i]) end
        print("[whatHub DEBUG]", table.concat(out, " "))
    end
end

-- Window
local Window
pcall(function()
    Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
        Name = "whatHub v1.5",
        LoadingTitle = "whatHub Loader",
        LoadingSubtitle = "Made by tennisballs9000",
        ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
        KeySystem = false
    })
end)
Window = Window or { CreateTab = function() return { CreateButton = function() end, CreateToggle = function() end, CreateSlider = function() end, CreateSearch = function() end } end }

local function notify(title, content, dur)
    dur = dur or 3
    pcall(function() Rayfield:Notify({ Title = title, Content = content, Duration = dur }) end)
end

-- Character refs - keep updated
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid  = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local HRP       = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function updateCharRefs(char)
    if not char then return end
    Character = char
    Humanoid  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    HRP       = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    dprint("Character refs updated")
end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(updateCharRefs)

-- Helpers
local function setNoclip(state)
    if not Character then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(Character:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function() part.CanCollide = not state end)
        end
    end
end

local function safeTeleportToCFrame(cf)
    if not Character or not HRP then return false end
    setNoclip(true)
    pcall(function() HRP.CFrame = cf end)
    task.wait(0.12)
    setNoclip(false)
    return true
end

-- streamed-area check
local function isAreaStreamed(position, radius, minParts)
    radius = radius or 25
    minParts = minParts or 6
    local ok, parts = pcall(function() return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, radius) end)
    if not ok or not parts then return false end
    local cnt = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then cnt = cnt + 1 end
    end
    return cnt >= minParts
end

-- Tabs
local MovementTab = Window:CreateTab("Movement", 4483362458)
local LegitTab     = Window:CreateTab("Legit", 4483362458)
local StagesTab    = Window:CreateTab("Stages", 4483362458)
local OtherTab     = Window:CreateTab("Other", 4483362458)
local OptimizationTab  = Window:CreateTab("Optimization Machine 9000", 4483362458) -- replaced Settings tab with Optimization
local EventsTab    = Window:CreateTab("Events", 4483362458)

-- Movement defaults
local DEFAULT_WALK = 16
local DEFAULT_JUMP = 50
_G.whatHubDebug = false
_G.whatHub_ws = _G.whatHub_ws or DEFAULT_WALK
_G.whatHub_jp = _G.whatHub_jp or DEFAULT_JUMP

MovementTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "WalkSpeed",
    Range = { DEFAULT_WALK, 500 },
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = _G.whatHub_ws,
    Flag = "WH_WalkSpeed",
    Callback = function(v)
        _G.whatHub_ws = v
        if Humanoid then pcall(function() Humanoid.WalkSpeed = v end) end
    end
})

MovementTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "JumpPower",
    Range = { DEFAULT_JUMP, 500 },
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = _G.whatHub_jp,
    Flag = "WH_JumpPower",
    Callback = function(v)
        _G.whatHub_jp = v
        if Humanoid then pcall(function() Humanoid.JumpPower = v end) end
    end
})

local NoSlowdown = false
MovementTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "No Slowdown",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "WH_NoSlow",
    Callback = function(v)
        NoSlowdown = v
        notify("Movement", "NoSlow " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF"))
    end
})

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if Humanoid then
        pcall(function()
            if _G.whatHub_ws and Humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= _G.whatHub_ws and not NoSlowdown then Humanoid.WalkSpeed = _G.whatHub_ws end
            if _G.whatHub_jp and Humanoid.JumpPower ~= _G.whatHub_jp and not NoSlowdown then Humanoid.JumpPower = _G.whatHub_jp end
            if NoSlowdown then
                if Humanoid.WalkSpeed < DEFAULT_WALK then Humanoid.WalkSpeed = DEFAULT_WALK end
                if Humanoid.JumpPower < DEFAULT_JUMP then Humanoid.JumpPower = DEFAULT_JUMP end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- Legit helpers
local function playNotificationSound()
    pcall(function()
        local s = Instance.new("Sound")
        s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://12222124"
        s.Volume = 0.18
        s.Parent = Workspace
        s:Play()
        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(s, 3)
    end)
end

LegitTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Show Code",
    Callback = function()
        local codeVal = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CodeDoor") and Workspace.CodeDoor:FindFirstChild("Code")
        if codeVal and codeVal:IsA("StringValue") then
            playNotificationSound()
            notify("Door Code", "Code: " .. tostring(codeVal.Value), 6)
        else
            playNotificationSound()
            notify("Door Code", "Code not found", 4)
        end
    end
})

-- Light switch toggle (uses ClickDetector interaction)
local lightActive = false
local lightTask = nil

LegitTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Light Switch",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        lightActive = state

        if lightTask then
            lightTask:Disconnect()
            lightTask = nil
        end

        lightTask = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local lightSwitch = workspace:FindFirstChild("light")
            if not lightSwitch then return end

            local interactive = lightSwitch:FindFirstChild("LightSwitch") and lightSwitch.LightSwitch:FindFirstChild("Interactive")
            local lightsOnBool = lightSwitch:FindFirstChild("LightsOn")
            if not interactive or not lightsOnBool then return end

            local clickDetector = interactive:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
            if not clickDetector then return end

            -- Only act if the state is not as desired
            if (lightActive and not lightsOnBool.Value) or (not lightActive and lightsOnBool.Value) then
                if not HRP then return end
                local originalCFrame = HRP.CFrame

                -- Teleport to switch
                safeTeleportToCFrame(interactive.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0))

                -- Simulate click (call MouseClick on ClickDetector)
                pcall(function()
                    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if player == LocalPlayer then
                            clickDetector.MouseClick:Fire(player)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end)

                -- Wait a short moment for boolvalue to update (or use a small poll to ensure)
                local waited = 0
                while waited < 2 and lightsOnBool and lightsOnBool.Value ~= lightActive do
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    waited = waited + 0.12
                end

                -- teleport back (fail-safe after 2 seconds if not matching desired state)
                safeTeleportToCFrame(originalCFrame)
            end
        end)
    end
})

-- Other settings (fog, ambience, haze, neon, killbricks, player events)
local OriginalLightingState = { FogStart = Lighting.FogStart, FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd }
local OriginalAtmosphereProps = nil
do
    local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    if atm then OriginalAtmosphereProps = { Density = atm.Density, Offset = atm.Offset, Color = atm.Color } end
end

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "No Fog",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then
            OriginalLightingState.FogStart = Lighting.FogStart
            OriginalLightingState.FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
            Lighting.FogStart = 0
            Lighting.FogEnd = 1e9
            local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atm then pcall(function() atm.Density = 0 end) end
            notify("Other", "NoFog enabled", 2)
        else
            Lighting.FogStart = OriginalLightingState.FogStart or 0
            Lighting.FogEnd = OriginalLightingState.FogEnd or 1000
            local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atm and OriginalAtmosphereProps then
                pcall(function()
                    atm.Density = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Density
                    atm.Offset  = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Offset
                    atm.Color   = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Color
                end)
            end
            notify("Other", "NoFog disabled", 2)
        end
    end
})

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Disable Ambient Sounds",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        -- updated ambient sound targets per user request
        local s1 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Rumble Ambience Interior Wind Turbo Shaft 5 (SFX)")
        local s2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Sound")
        if s1 and s1:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s1.Volume = v and 0 or 1 end) end
        if s2 and s2:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s2.Volume = v and 0 or 1 end) end
        notify("Other", "Disable Ambient Sounds " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF"), 2)
    end
})

-- haze toggle
local Atmos = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
if not Atmos then
    Atmos = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
    Atmos.Parent = Lighting
end
local originalHaze = Atmos.Haze

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Disable Haze",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then
            Atmos.Haze = 0
        else
            Atmos.Haze = originalHaze or 10
        end
        notify("Other", "Disable Haze " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF"), 2)
    end
})

-- Neon removal
local neonCache = {}
local function removeNeonNow()
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
            neonCache[obj] = Enum.Material.Neon
            pcall(function() obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic end)
        end
    end
end
local function restoreNeonNow()
    for part, mat in pairs(neonCache) do
        if part and part.Parent and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function() part.Material = mat end)
        end
    end
    neonCache = {}
end

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Remove Neon",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        if state then
            removeNeonNow()
            notify("Other", "Neon parts changed to Plastic", 2)
        else
            restoreNeonNow()
            notify("Other", "Neon parts restored", 2)
        end
    end
})

-- antikillbricks (persistent)
local killWatcherConnection = nil
local function removeTouchFromInstance(inst)
    if not inst then return 0 end
    local removed = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TouchTransmitter") or child:IsA("TouchInterest") then
            pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
            removed = removed + 1
        end
    end
    return removed
end

local function purgeAllKillTouches()
    local count = 0
    for _, inst in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            local lname = tostring(inst.Name):lower()
            if lname:find("kill") or inst.Name == "Part" then
                count = count + removeTouchFromInstance(inst)
            end
        end
    end
    return count
end

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Remove KillBricks",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then
            local removed = purgeAllKillTouches()
            killWatcherConnection = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if obj:IsA("TouchTransmitter") or obj:IsA("TouchInterest") then
                    local parent = obj.Parent
                    if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local pname = tostring(parent.Name):lower()
                        if pname:find("kill") or parent.Name == "Part" then
                            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            notify("Other", "KillBrick remover enabled - removed " .. tostring(removed) .. " currently.", 3)
        else
            if killWatcherConnection then killWatcherConnection:Disconnect(); killWatcherConnection = nil end
            notify("Other", "KillBrick remover disabled", 2)
        end
    end
})

-- Player event notifications - kept per request
local PlayerEventsToggle = OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Player Event Notifications",
    CurrentValue = true,
    Callback = function() end
})
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)

end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    hum.Died:Connect(function()
        if PlayerEventsToggle.CurrentValue then notify("Player Event", LocalPlayer.Name .. " died", 2) end

end)

-- Enable All Settings master toggle (snapshot / apply / restore)
local masterActive = false
local masterSnapshot = {
    ambientVolumes = {},
    haze = nil,
    neonCacheSnapshot = {},
    playerEventsEnabled = nil,
    noFog = nil
}

local function takeSnapshot()
    local s1 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Sound")
    local s2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Echoing Wind - 60sec Horror Ambient")
    masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[1] = (s1 and s1:IsA("Sound")) and s1.Volume or nil
    masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[2] = (s2 and s2:IsA("Sound")) and s2.Volume or nil

    masterSnapshot.haze = Atmos.Haze

    masterSnapshot.neonCacheSnapshot = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
            masterSnapshot.neonCacheSnapshot[obj] = Enum.Material.Neon
        end
    end

    masterSnapshot.playerEventsEnabled = PlayerEventsToggle.CurrentValue

    masterSnapshot.noFog = (Lighting.FogStart == 0 and Lighting.FogEnd > 1e6)
end

local function applyAllSettings()
    local s1 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Sound")
    local s2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Echoing Wind - 60sec Horror Ambient")
    if s1 and s1:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s1.Volume = 0 end) end
    if s2 and s2:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s2.Volume = 0 end) end

    Atmos.Haze = 0

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
            neonCache[obj] = Enum.Material.Neon
            pcall(function() obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic end)
        end
    end

    if not masterSnapshot.noFog then
        pcall(function()
            Lighting.FogStart = 0
            Lighting.FogEnd = 1e9 -- lol
        end)
    end

    purgeAllKillTouches()
end

local function restoreAllSettings()
    local s1 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Sound")
    local s2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Echoing Wind - 60sec Horror Ambient")
    if s1 and s1:IsA("Sound") and masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[1] ~= nil then pcall(function() s1.Volume = masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[1] end) end
    if s2 and s2:IsA("Sound") and masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[2] ~= nil then pcall(function() s2.Volume = masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[2] end) end

    if masterSnapshot.haze ~= nil then
        pcall(function() Atmos.Haze = masterSnapshot.haze end)
    end

    for part, _ in pairs(neonCache) do
        if part and part.Parent and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if masterSnapshot.neonCacheSnapshot[part] then
                pcall(function() part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end)
            end
        end
    end
    neonCache = {}

    if masterSnapshot.noFog == false then
        Lighting.FogStart = OriginalLightingState.FogStart or 0
        Lighting.FogEnd = OriginalLightingState.FogEnd or 1000
        local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
        if atm and OriginalAtmosphereProps then
            pcall(function()
                atm.Density = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Density
                atm.Offset = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Offset
                atm.Color = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Color
            end)
        end
    end
end

LegitTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Enable All Settings",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then
            if masterActive then return end
            takeSnapshot()
            masterActive = true
            applyAllSettings()
            notify("Legit", "Enable All Settings ON (temporary override active)", 3)
        else
            if not masterActive then return end
            restoreAllSettings()
            masterActive = false
            notify("Legit", "Enable All Settings OFF (reverted)", 3)
        end
    end
})

-- Stage Loader - improved list retained
LegitTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Stage Loader",
    Callback = function()
        if not HRP then notify("Stage Loader", "Root part is missing.", 3); return end
        local origin = HRP.CFrame
        notify("Stage Loader", "Scanning stage streaming state...", 3)

        local allStages = {
            CFrame.new(8294,4,-543),
            CFrame.new(8622,4,-544),
            (Workspace:FindFirstChild("TeleportDestination") and Workspace.TeleportDestination:IsA("BasePart") and (Workspace.TeleportDestination.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,5,0))) or CFrame.new(8534,36,55),
            CFrame.new(9830,42,303),
            CFrame.new(10008,50,3089),
            CFrame.new(10627,50,3110),
            CFrame.new(10641,129,5048),
            CFrame.new(10616,127,5013),
            CFrame.new(10632,127,5210),
            CFrame.new(10578,127,5278), -- Altar
            CFrame.new(10552,152,5182), -- Mango Ball
            CFrame.new(10618,127,5279),  -- Black Room
            CFrame.new(10606, 126, 6068)
        }

        local toVisit = {}
        for _, cf in ipairs(allStages) do
            if not isAreaStreamed(cf.Position, 25, 6) then
                table.insert(toVisit, cf)
            end
        end

        if #toVisit == 0 then
            notify("Stage Loader", "All stage areas appear streamed already, nothing to do.", 3)
            return
        end

        local startTick = tick()
        local aborted = false
        for _, cf in ipairs(toVisit) do
            if tick() - startTick > 10 then aborted = true; break end
            pcall(function() HRP.CFrame = cf end)
            local t0 = tick()
            local okStream = false
            repeat
                task.wait(0.25)
                if isAreaStreamed(cf.Position, 25, 6) then okStream = true; break end
            until tick() - t0 > 3 or tick() - startTick > 10
            if not okStream then
                pcall(function() HRP.CFrame = origin end)
                notify("Stage Loader", "Stage area failed to stream; restored origin.", 4)
                aborted = true
                break
            end
            task.wait(0.6)
        end
        pcall(function() if origin then HRP.CFrame = origin end end)
        if aborted then
            notify("Stage Loader", "Sequence aborted (timeout/stream failure).", 4)
        else
            notify("Stage Loader", "All unstreamed stages visited and returned.", 4)
        end
    end
})

-- Third person unlock attempt on load (teleport + jump)
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(0.8)
    if HRP and Humanoid then
        local originalPos = HRP.CFrame
        local stage3CF = CFrame.new(9830,42,303)
        safeTeleportToCFrame(stage3CF + Vector3.new(0,3,0))
        task.wait(1) -- hold to ensure the unlock part loads
        pcall(function() Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
        task.wait(0.5)
        safeTeleportToCFrame(originalPos)
        notify("Third Person", "Attempted unlock.", 2)
    end
end)

-- ProximityPrompt AutoFarm (keeps original behavior)
local autoFarmActive = false
local autoFarmConnection = nil
local originalCFrame = nil

LegitTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "ProximityPrompt AutoFarm",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        autoFarmActive = state
        local interactPart = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Interact")
        if not interactPart then
            notify("Legit", "Interact part not found in workspace", 3)
            return
        end
        local prompt = interactPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
        if not prompt then
            notify("Legit", "ProximityPrompt 'Interact' not found", 3)
            return
        end

        if state then
            if not HRP then notify("Legit", "HumanoidRootPart missing", 3); return end
            originalCFrame = HRP.CFrame

            -- Freeze player
            if Humanoid then pcall(function() Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0; Humanoid.JumpPower = 0 end) end

            -- Teleport to interact part
            safeTeleportToCFrame(interactPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0))

            -- Modify prompt properties safely
            pcall(function()
                prompt.HoldDuration = 0
                prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
                prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 200
            end)

            -- Spam the prompt
            autoFarmConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if autoFarmActive then
                    pcall(function()
                        prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                        prompt:InputHoldEnd()
                    end)
                end
            end)
            notify("Legit", "ProximityPrompt AutoFarm enabled", 2)

        else
            -- Stop spamming
            if autoFarmConnection then autoFarmConnection:Disconnect(); autoFarmConnection = nil end

            -- Restore player movement
            if Humanoid and _G.whatHub_ws and _G.whatHub_jp then
                pcall(function()
                    Humanoid.WalkSpeed = _G.whatHub_ws
                    Humanoid.JumpPower = _G.whatHub_jp
                end)
            end

            -- Teleport back to original position
            if originalCFrame then
                safeTeleportToCFrame(originalCFrame)
                originalCFrame = nil
            end

            notify("Legit", "ProximityPrompt AutoFarm disabled", 2)
        end
    end
})

-- Optimization Machine 9000 - helper to remove by path array
local function removeByPath(pathArray)
    if type(pathArray) ~= "table" or #pathArray == 0 then return false end
    local ok, target = pcall(function()
        local cur = Workspace
        for i, nm in ipairs(pathArray) do
            if not cur then return nil end
            local child = cur:FindFirstChild(nm)
            if not child then return nil end
            cur = child
        end
        return cur
    end)
    if not ok or not target then return false end
    -- detach then destroy to minimize transient overhead
    pcall(function() target.Parent = nil end)
    pcall(function() target:Destroy() end)
    return true
end

local SPEED: number = 300
local SPRINT_MULT: number = 2.5
local TURN_SENS: number = 0.003
local PITCH_CLAMP: number = math.rad(85)

local INVERT_AD: boolean = true
local BOMB_PITCH_OFFSET: number = math.rad(90)

local tracked: BasePart? = nil
local bodyVelocity: BodyVelocity? = nil
local active: boolean = false
local yaw: number = 0
local pitch: number = 0
local heartbeatConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local mouseMoveConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

local keys: { [Enum.KeyCode]: boolean } = {}

local function findBomb(): BasePart?
	local obj = workspace:FindFirstChild(BOMB_NAME, true)
	if not obj then return nil end
	if obj:IsA("BasePart") then return obj end
	if obj:IsA("Model") then
		return obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	end
	return nil
end

local function ensureThrust(part: BasePart): BodyVelocity
	local existing = part:FindFirstChild("NoraPilot") :: BodyVelocity?
	if existing then return existing end
	local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.Name = "NoraPilot"
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	bv.P = 10000
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = part
	return bv
end

local function cleanup()
	if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
		bodyVelocity:Destroy()
	end
	bodyVelocity = nil
	tracked = nil
	active = false
	keys = {}
	if heartbeatConn then heartbeatConn:Disconnect() heartbeatConn = nil end
	if mouseMoveConn then mouseMoveConn:Disconnect() mouseMoveConn = nil end
	Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	if LocalPlayer.Character then
		local head = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
			Camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or head
		end
	end
end

local function start()
	tracked = findBomb()
	if not tracked then
		print("бомбы нет")
		return
	end

	bodyVelocity = ensureThrust(tracked)
	active = true
	keys = {}

	local cf = tracked.CFrame
	yaw = math.atan2(-cf.LookVector.X, -cf.LookVector.Z)
	pitch = math.asin(cf.LookVector.Y)

	Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	print("пилот на " .. tracked.Name)

	heartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		if not active then return end
		if not tracked or not tracked.Parent then
			cleanup()
			return
		end
		if not bodyVelocity or not bodyVelocity.Parent then
			bodyVelocity = ensureThrust(tracked)
		end

		local rot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch, yaw, 0)
		local forward = -rot.LookVector
		local right = rot.RightVector
		local up = Vector3.yAxis

		local adSign: number = if INVERT_AD then -1 else 1

		local move = Vector3.zero
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.W] then move += forward end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.S] then move -= forward end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.D] then move += right * adSign end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.A] then move -= right * adSign end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.Space] then move += up end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] then move -= up end

		local spd = SPEED
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] then spd *= SPRINT_MULT end

		if move.Magnitude > 0 then
			move = move.Unit * spd
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = move

		local bombRot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch + BOMB_PITCH_OFFSET, yaw, 0)
		tracked.CFrame = CFrame.new(tracked.Position) * bombRot
		Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(tracked.Position - forward * 12 + up * 4, tracked.Position + forward * 10)
	end)

	mouseMoveConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if not active then return end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
		if not UserInputService.MouseBehavior then return end
		yaw -= input.Delta.X * TURN_SENS
		pitch -= input.Delta.Y * TURN_SENS
		pitch = math.clamp(pitch, -PITCH_CLAMP, PITCH_CLAMP)
	end)

	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gpe: boolean)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == TOGGLE_KEY then
		if active then
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
			UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
			cleanup()
			print("вышел")
		else
			start()
		end
		return
	end
	if active then
		keys[input.KeyCode] = true
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
	keys[input.KeyCode] = false
end)

-- FTAP Super Fling by Masbilhaq (Fixed Map/Ground Fling Bug)

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "FTAP - Masbilhaq",
   LoadingTitle = "FTAP Script",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by Masbilhaq",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)

local isSuperFlingActive = false
local flingPower = 300

local Toggle = Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Super Fling",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "SuperFlingToggle",
   Callback = function(Value)
      isSuperFlingActive = Value
   end,
})

local Slider = Tab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Fling Strength",
   Range = {100, 10000},
   Increment = 50,
   Suffix = " Power",
   CurrentValue = 300,
   Flag = "FlingStrengthSlider",
   Callback = function(Value)
      flingPower = Value
   end,
})

Tab:CreateLabel("Made by Masbilhaq")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(model)
	if model.Name == "GrabParts" then
		local grabPart = model:FindFirstChild("GrabPart")
		if grabPart then
			local weld = grabPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("WeldConstraint")
			if weld and weld.Part1 then
				local targetPart = weld.Part1
				model:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(function()
					if not model.Parent and isSuperFlingActive then
						local char = player.Character
						
						-- PERBAIKAN BUG:
						-- 1. Pastikan part bukan bagian badan kita
						-- 2. Pastikan part BUKAN bagian dari Terrain/Map
						-- 3. Pastikan part TIDAK di-Anchor (kalo di-anchor berarti itu tanah/pijakan)
						if targetPart and not targetPart:IsDescendantOf(char) and not targetPart.Anchored and targetPart ~= Workspace.Terrain then
							local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
							targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = cam.CFrame.LookVector * (flingPower * 10) + Vector3.new(0, flingPower * 2, 0)
						end
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end)
